description.value: Seto's Wok & Grill is a restaurant on northern Vancouver Island offering wok and grilled dishes. Situated on Trustee Road near the Port McNeill area, it sits along a route cyclists may travel while exploring the northern Island. The name suggests an Asian-influenced grill menu that could offer a satisfying hot meal after a day on the road.
